channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Angry Voters Usher in Beginning of the End to the Trump Era
item.description: The electoral backlash extended even into deep red states and indicated that President Trump has lost his hold over the coalition that lifted him to the White House twice.

item.title: NPR: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
item.description: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

item.title: BBC News: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
item.description: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

item.title: The Guardian: The death knell of Trumpism has finally sounded | Moira Donegan
item.description: The electorate voted decisively to curb the president’s power There’s a certain freedom in low expectations. Going in to Tuesday’s midterm elections, forecasts were so grim for the Republicans that poll watchers started…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Netanyahu bet on Trump – but both lost
item.description: Israel's political establishment grapples with US voter rejection of White House ally and own contribution towards it.

item.title: Ars Technica: Binance says hackers who stole billions in crypto spent months planning heist
item.description: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling, and fake job interviews.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
item.description: Ahead of the midterms, WIRED talked to New York City’s mayor about data centers, AI in schools, and the future of the Democratic party.

item.title: WIRED Science: ‘You Don’t Put Your Head in the Sand for 4 Years’: Colossal CEO Ben Lamm on Working With Trump
item.description: The company’s cofounder recently convinced the Trump administration to support an initiative to gather DNA samples from endangered species.

item.title: WIRED Business: ‘Musk’ Director Alex Gibney Wants to Know if Democrats Can Now Hold Elon Musk Accountable
item.description: Spending hundreds of millions of dollars means nothing to Elon Musk, director Alex Gibney says.

item.title: The New Yorker: Finally, the Beginning of Trump’s End
item.description: Reflections on a midterm campaign in which our octogenarian President waged war—against algae in the Reflecting Pool.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Blake Ritson Thinks You Should Marry Your Best Friend
item.description: The Gilded Age is back and Oscar Van Rhijn is finally on top, to the delight of Blake Ritson.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Long Island Home Norman Jaffe Built for a Speed-Dealing Diet Doctor
item.description: A calm, bright 1970s space in Old Westbury with a nifty pool house.

item.title: Fox59: Bayh claims victory in Indiana Sec. of State race, Engling concedes
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS -- A Democrat is projected to have been elected to a statewide executive office for the first time in more than a decade. According to preliminary election results from the Associated Press, Beau Bayh is pro…

item.title: Mirror Indy: AP: André Carson retains 7th District seat
item.description: J.D. Ford declares victory over Victoria Spartz, Shreve wins reelection. The post AP: André Carson retains 7th District seat appeared first on Mirror Indy .
